plugins.name: hashicorp-deck
plugins.description: HashiCorp-branded presentation skills. `hashicorp-deck-html` builds single-file HTML5 scroll presentations in the HashiCorp brand style. `hashicorp-deck-htmltopptx` converts an existing HTML presentation into an editable .pptx re-typeset on the official HashiCorp CY26 kit: Inter, the signature glow gradient and HashiCorp's own slide layouts.

plugins.name: ibm-deck
plugins.description: IBM-branded presentation skills. `ibm-deck-htmltopptx` converts an existing HTML presentation into an editable .pptx re-typeset on the official IBM template: IBM Plex, the Carbon palette and IBM's own slide layouts.
